verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a directory blurb saying Datadog can track code changes and deployments alongside application performance through GitHub and GitLab integrations. That points to deploy-to-performance correlation, but it is a single thin, first-party marketing mention. missing for 10: documented release/deployment tracking feature details, configuration-change tracking, explicit regression-to-deploy correlation workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can correlate regressions with deploys and configuration changes via release or change tracking

citations.quote: Track code changes, deployments, and application performance in real time with integrations across software delivery platforms like GitLab and GitHub.
